E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Daddy Daughter Day: A day out with Erica at the roller-skating rink leaves Murray wishing that he hadn't asked his daughter to confide in him about her life. (S1 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Weathering Heights: Phil's excited when he's invited onto the local news. And his day gets even better when he meets his weatherman hero, Rainer Shine (guest star Nathan Fillion). (S8 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Halloween 4: The Revenge of Rod Skyhook: Luke's Halloween party isn't going well. The Dunphys decide it needs a visit from Rod Skyhook, some promotion and adult supervision... (S8 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Grab It!: Jay's favourite place in the world may be losing some of its charm when Phil considers becoming a member. And Claire mistakes her influence on Alex's life choices. (S8 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Thanksgiving Jamboree: Phil spares no expense on a Thanksgiving jamboree. And Hayley has to tell her dad that she'd rather spend the holidays with her boyfriend. (S8 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Star of the Backstage: Marge gets nostalgic about her days as stage manager of her high school play and reunites the cast for a re-run. They say you should never go back... (S33 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart's in Jail!: When a phone scammer who's pretending to be Bart fools Grampa into giving away $10,000, it's Homer who's the real victim. According to Homer, anyway. (S33 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror XXXII: Another Halloween helping of spooky tales, featuring some chilling takes on classic films including Parasite, Nightmare on Elm Street and, er, Bambi. (S33 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Wayz We Were: Evergreen Terrace becomes one giant traffic jam thanks to a new GPS app. Moe reunites with an old flame - and this time he's determined to not screw it up. (S33 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: A new friendship leads Ste to relapse. Dee Dee springs into action when Nancy's health takes a turn. And a father confronts his daughter.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pilot: US comedy about a group of New York City police detectives. A talented but carefree detective is taken aback when a strict new captain takes over at his precinct. (S1 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Ladies of London: The New...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Reign - Brand new series: Martha hosts an elegant My Fair Lady-themed picnic. Wouldn't it be loverly to have a refined, tranquil afternoon? Alas, confrontation beckons... (Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck Down Under
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: It's time for circus night, which is pretty apt considering the amount of clowning in the crew. A heated argument breaks out in the galley. (S3 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Welcome to Wrexham, The Good Ship Murder, Married at First Sight UK, Coronation Street and Nadiya's Simple Spices are just some of the great TV shows up for review. (S22 Ep7)
